Upload a ZIP containing one TF root with otype.tf. Checks core WARP node typing, slot containment, required files, and archive safety. This static preflight does not run Text-Fabric or Context-Fabric and does not prove source fidelity. Maximum upload: 3 MB; maximum unpacked size: 64 MB.

422.description: Unsafe, oversized, or malformed Text-Fabric ZIP

post.description: Upload one unencrypted, reflowable EPUB. An optional audited repair pass revalidates the source before export. Maximum upload: 3 MB; maximum ZIP: 4 MB.

200.description: ZIP bundle with manifest, original source, and verified Text-Fabric files. A score-gated PDF contains its report but no TF output.

post.description: Upload a PDF of at most 10 pages. OCR and source comparison gate TF export at a score above 95%. A gated result is still a ZIP containing the report. The score is OCR evidence, not transcription accuracy. Maximum upload: 3 MB; maximum ZIP: 4 MB.

200.description: ZIP bundle with manifest, original source, and verified Text-Fabric files. A score-gated PDF contains its report but no TF output.

post.summary: Convert PDF to TEI and Text-Fabric

200.description: ZIP bundle with manifest, original source, and verified Text-Fabric files. A score-gated PDF contains its report but no TF output.

post.description: Upload one document (up to 3 MB). UTF-8 .txt runs in the API; PDF, DOCX, PPTX, HTML, and Markdown require a separately installed Docling Python worker. The API validates a Context Fabric v1 graph and stores the completed job and graph.json in the shared Supabase job store. A verified user token is required.

post.description: Upload a .corpus, .zip, .ctei, or .cusx archive of at most 3 MB. A verified Supabase user token is required. Text-Fabric archives run real Text-Fabric and Context-Fabric load cycles; invalid supported archives return 200 with valid=false and reasons. The path field is the uploaded filename. Server paths, loaded corpus names, and legacy conversion job IDs are not accepted by this hosted endpoint.
